output.reason: This company regulation sets a payroll rule that changes how benefits are classified for PPh 21 withholding on permanent employees. It provides benefits in kind: a canteen lunch for all workers, a company-leased apartment of up to Rp6,000,000 per month for managers and above at head office, and work clothing/PPE. Pasal 28 states these in-kind benefits are not part of wages and are not counted as employee income when the company computes PPh 21. That rule determines which benefits enter gross income. Pasal 29 only restates the general withholding rule and the JHT/JP employee-contribution deductions without changing them.
